## What

<!-- One or two sentences: what this pull request does. Refs #<issue> while work is left on it; Closes #<issue> when this pull request meets every acceptance criterion of the issue. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem it solves, and the requirement or decision behind it (docs/epics.md, an ADR). -->

## Changes

<!-- The notable changes, grouped by crate or area. Mention anything that moves a layering rule, a size ceiling or the allow-list. -->

## Testing

<!-- How you verified it: the failing test that came first, the commands you ran (cargo fmt, clippy, test, the xtask checks), and anything you could not verify. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch starts with `feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`, `refactor/`, `perf/`, `test/`, `ci/`, `build/` or `release/`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and carry no AI attribution
- [ ] A failing test came first for a behaviour change
- [ ] Docs touched by the change are updated in this pull request
- [ ] Agent-facing text and errors are English with stable codes
